decision_scope: The route-only experiment is retained as evidence but not adopted into the retained runtime. Both variants keep overlapped preparation.
export_scope: Fixed stored-file reads and derived writes on test-env only; no tests, builds, application, emulator, runtime probe, account, device transport or lease operation.

early.comparison_scope: Every visible 8-bit framebuffer pixel; no excluded regions or masks

settled.comparison_scope: Every visible 8-bit framebuffer pixel; no excluded regions or masks

historical_checks_scope: Previously completed tool-only host fixtures, with pre-review/final-source scope retained exactly in the frozen revision 2 manifest; separate from physical results and never rerun here.

historical_host_fixture_checks.independent_read_only_review: Initial parameter-token gap fixed; final review found no blocking issue

independent_item1_scope: Separate source and treatment from item1; no serial preparation variant, pooled samples, or repeated assisted attempt.
limitations: Warm process launches in one device boot; not cold boot or cache-evicted starts.
Request timing precedes execvp of the native launch command; it is not physical-tap latency.
SEND acceptance is a successful submission, not driver completion or optical panel completion.
Driver completion flags are retained per attempt and never substituted for primary endpoints.
First business frame does not establish that every background cover has completed.
Final PNGs are logical Slint snapshots at application exit, before framebuffer compensation.
Both predefined warmups and all twelve predefined measured launches are retained; only the warmups are excluded from primary performance distributions.
Memory/input sampling follows a common first-business SEND plus 1500 ms gate; the clock marker is not an exact subsequent sample time or a whole-lifetime peak measurement.
The content-frame.raw pair retains every early visible-pixel difference; it is not required to match and is never masked.
The settled-frame.raw pair must match at a scheduled target of first business SEND acceptance plus 1500 ms; actual capture-request lateness is reported separately.
The scheduled framebuffer observation is separate from all primary startup endpoints; any EPDC projection remains derived rather than optical evidence.
No new touch, rotation, sleep/wake or model qualification.
Shell uptime records retain their limited resolution and scheduling delay.
Stage spans may overlap and must not be summed into end-to-end startup time.
request_origin_clarification: The helper samples CLOCK_MONOTONIC before writing/closing request.json and execvp of lipc-set-prop com.lab126.appmgrd start for native Scriptlet dispatch; this is not direct UI-process exec.
structural_finding: Candidate removes accepted noninitial pre-Ready forced-full GC16 replacements. Candidate 02/03/06 still render a no-SEND attempt; neither those attempts nor partial updates are additional full submissions.
unimplemented_design: Bounded coalescing or backend-loop changes remain unimplemented hypotheses; no performance gain is asserted.
